faqs.question: What type of vehicle do you use for pet transportation?
faqs.answer: We use a comfortable SUV with full air conditioning to provide a private, safe, and stress-free journey for your pets.

faqs.question: How many pets can travel in the car?
faqs.answer: Our vehicle can accommodate up to 3 large dogs or 4 medium-sized dogs, depending on their size and comfort requirements.

faqs.question: Is the vehicle air-conditioned?
faqs.answer: Yes, continuous air conditioning is maintained throughout the journey to keep pets cool and calm in Bali's tropical climate.

faqs.question: Can pet owners travel with their pets?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Up to 2 human companions are welcome to ride alongside their pets at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Do you provide pet transportation outside Bali?
faqs.answer: At the moment, our transportation service is dedicated to destinations across Bali island only.

faqs.question: Can I request walking times?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend early morning (07:00 - 09:00) or late afternoon (16:30 - 18:30) to avoid hot pavement and excessive sun.

faqs.question: What if my dog is reactive to other dogs?
faqs.answer: Our walks are private and handlers are trained to manage space, choose quiet paths, and ensure zero confrontation with street dogs.

spotlightStory.title: Luna's First Sunset Run at Echo Beach
spotlightStory.quote: PawCab completely changed how we explore Bali. Luna hopped in without any hesitation!
spotlightStory.story: Before discovering PawCab, getting Luna into any regular car was a stressful ordeal. She would pace, pant, and refuse to enter. PawCab provided a flat, clean floor mat, gentle air conditioning, and a driver who understood pets. By the time we arrived at Echo Beach, Luna was relaxed, happy, and energized for an unforgettable sunset run.

storiesList.title: Luna's First Sunset Run at Echo Beach
storiesList.imageAlt: Two happy dogs running freely on open grass in the sunshine
storiesList.excerpt: Luna used to get car-sick on normal rides. With PawCab's spacious cabin and gentle driving, she had the calmest ride of her life.

storiesList.title: Milo & Koko: Moving to Their New Villa in Ubud
storiesList.imageAlt: Cute calm cat looking comfortably through soft light
storiesList.excerpt: Relocating two rescue cats across Bali can be noisy and nerve-wracking. PawCab provided a quiet, crate-secure environment.
storiesList.fullStory: Cats are sensitive to motion and loud noises. When moving our villa from Seminyak up to Ubud, we were dreading the two-hour transit. PawCab arrived on time, secured the carriers safely, and took the scenic roads with minimal stops.
storiesList.quote: Door-to-door, prompt arrival, and zero complaints from our two cats the whole trip.

storiesList.title: Rocky's Post-Surgery Comfort Ride
storiesList.imageAlt: Golden dog resting peacefully wrapped in blanket
storiesList.excerpt: Transporting a 35kg dog after orthopedic surgery required utmost gentleness. PawCab's handler helped lift him with a stretcher mat.
storiesList.fullStory: Rocky underwent knee surgery at Sunset Vet and could not put weight on his back leg. The PawCab driver brought a specialized lifting harness and drove at a steady pace to avoid any jolts.
storiesList.quote: The gentle handling made all the difference during a very anxious morning.
